business_problem: “We’re responsible for surfacing insights on campaign and creative performance so the team can make faster, more confident decisions.” Every week, the team processes performance data across thousands of campaigns and hundreds of millions of impressions — a scale that makes manual reporting unsustainable.
solution_summary: ZURU is a global product powerhouse reshaping categories in the world’s largest retailers. From fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) phenomena like Rascals diapers to viral toy sensations such as Bunch O Balloons and XSHOT, the company is known for disrupting markets with speed, innovation and scale. That same philosophy drove their efforts to modernize their data infrastructure. Now, with the Databricks Data + AI Platform as their foundation, ZURU has automated complex marketing workflows and accelerated content innovation to drive faster, more impactful business outcomes. Every week, the team processes performance data across thousands of campaigns and hundreds of millions of impressions — a scale that makes manual reporting unsustainable. What once required tedious spreadsheet work is now centralized, standardized and accessible in real time.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow Jobs
solution_components.role: Schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and production jobs.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow
solution_components.role: Coordinates ingestion and transformation workflows across the lakehouse.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables under Unity Catalog governance, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include Today, ZURU operates a robust, cloud-native infrastructure supporting 600-plus data pipelines and over 4,000 tables across dozens of catalogs.
